description: This source file implements TPM HMAC operations, including single call and segmented HMAC to handle data of different sizes. It provides functions for generating HMACs using TPM resources, managing TPM sessions and contexts, and integrating with a resource manager for secure key handling.

methods.name: UniqueEsysPtr<TPM2B_DIGEST> OneshotHmac(TpmResourceManager & resource_manager,ESYS_TR key_handle,TpmAuth auth,const uint8_t * data,size_t data_size)
methods.description: Performs a TPM HMAC operation on data small enough to be processed in a single command.

methods.name: UniqueEsysPtr<TPM2B_DIGEST> SegmentedHmac(TpmResourceManager & resource_manager,ESYS_TR key_handle,TpmAuth key_auth,const uint8_t * data,size_t data_size)
methods.description: Performs a TPM HMAC operation on data that is too large for a single command, by segmenting the data and updating the TPM sequence.

methods.name: UniqueEsysPtr<TPM2B_DIGEST> TpmHmac(TpmResourceManager & resource_manager,ESYS_TR key_handle,TpmAuth auth,const uint8_t * data,size_t data_size)
methods.description: Public function that delegates the HMAC operation to either OneshotHmac or SegmentedHmac based on data size.

methods.name: UniqueEsysPtr<TPM2B_DIGEST> TpmHmacWithContext(TpmResourceManager & resource_manager,const std::string & context,const uint8_t * data,size_t data_size)
methods.description: Performs an HMAC operation with a specified context, creating a signing key if needed, and ignoring the context parameter for better key reuse.
